admissibility.archiveDataLaw: Pin official URL, ZIP and checksum bytes, SHA-256, byte size, retrieval time, schema, and timestamp unit; replacement or partition gaps are UNKNOWN until reconciled.
admissibility.familyPValueLaw: Use a predeclared White Reality Check, Hansen SPA, Romano-Wolf stepdown, or Bonferroni over every attempted configuration; null-centered chronological blocks preserve dependence.
admissibility.fundingDataLaw: Keep funding separate from trading fees and preserve each row's direction, actual interval, funding rate, and mark/index-price evidence.
admissibility.unknownLaw: Any material missing fact is UNKNOWN, never zero and never PASS.

capacityAndDrawdownGates.aggregationLaw: Aggregate every simultaneous leg and position at each timestamp before testing the USD 1000 capacity requirement.
capacityAndDrawdownGates.drawdownBoundaryLaw: Equal to 40 percent passes; greater than 40 percent fails.
capacityAndDrawdownGates.equityLaw: Marked portfolio equity includes open positions, all fills, fees, funding, borrow, concurrent legs, collateral and liquidation constraints.
capacityAndDrawdownGates.makerLaw: Maker requires causal latency, strict trade-through, and sufficient aggressive traded size at the order price; touch alone is not a fill.
capacityAndDrawdownGates.rankingMetricLaw: Capacity-capped net LCB in micro-USD per USD 1000 per 86400 wall-clock exposure seconds; zero-trade intervals, all legs, fees, funding, borrow and slippage remain in the denominator.
capacityAndDrawdownGates.takerLaw: Taker requires causal book-depth walking for the full quantity; daily public volume is a proxy only.
capacityAndDrawdownGates.usdmRpiCoverageLaw: Normal USD-M depth and bookTicker exclude RPI; aggTrades can aggregate RPI without identifying it; rpiDepth aggregates and can hide crossed levels. Require a conservative bound proving fill and capacity outcomes invariant to missing RPI detail or return UNKNOWN.

feeScenarioTruth.positiveLaw: Each required scenario must independently have a strictly positive simultaneous net LCB; family p is the maximum required-scenario p.

scenarios.law: Venue-relevant public regular fees without BNB or promotion; unknown USD-M rates block affected families.
Spot includes standard, special, tax, buyer/seller and discount fields; USD-M uses the account commission rate. No signed call is authorized by S-META1.
Add two basis points to every entry and exit fill on every leg, after the applicable base-fee scenario.
Advertised 25 percent BNB discount is sensitivity only because toggle, balance, pair eligibility, promotion and account state are unknown.
The futures fee FAQ values are a hypothetical calculation example only and cannot fill public or account USD-M rate fields.

freeze.bindingLaw: Any identity, count, gate, fee scenario, or winner-policy change after an active result is disclosed creates a new registry version and a fresh holdout.

holdoutRules.outcomeChronologyLaw: The registry and complete attempt ledger must be frozen strictly before first active outcome access; each family candidate is locked and authorized before one holdout open.
holdoutRules.periodDisjointnessLaw: Canonical expanded prior-period intervals are digest-recomputed; their maximum end plus embargo must be strictly before each authorized family and winner holdout period. Missing or mismatched inventory is UNKNOWN.
holdoutRules.sharedHoldoutLaw: Shared holdout evidence is valid only when every participating contract and the seven-family multiplicity set were frozen before any result disclosure.
holdoutRules.winnerFailureLaw: A failed or contaminated fresh winner holdout produces NO_GO; no runner-up may consume the exposed holdout.

multiplicity.bootstrapPlusOneLaw: Every raw scenario p uses p=(1+null_exceedances)/4097; Bonferroni then uses min(1,A_f*p_raw), so no p below 1/4097 is admissible.
multiplicity.familyEntryLaw: All seven frozen families enter Holm. Missing, inadmissible, pending-ledger, failed, and abandoned families remain with effective p=1.
multiplicity.familyLcbLaw: Each 1/280 one-sided family LCB comes only from one independently locked candidate on one untouched family holdout; otherwise use a selection-simultaneous LCB.
multiplicity.familyPreauthorizationLaw: Attempt count, inference procedure and receipt/config, 4096 replicate count, block specification and seed, fee scenarios, execution law, candidate, universe, dataset, period, prior-period inventory, sample and ranking floors are fixed in the canonical family authorization before first access.
multiplicity.withinFamilyBonferroniLaw: p_family=min(1,A_f*min_raw_p), with A_f counting every completed, failed, abandoned, and manually inspected configuration.

verdictPolicy.freshHoldoutPrecedence: Before fresh holdout access, any material unresolved fact is UNKNOWN. After one deterministic winner consumes it, only a canonical measured failure or independently receipt-proven contamination is operational NO_GO with no fallback; a caller FAIL label alone remains UNKNOWN.
verdictPolicy.noGo: All seven families are terminal and every possible winner has a conclusive failed verification gate with no material unknown, or the one fresh deterministic winner has a canonical failed result or independently receipt-proven contamination. NO_GO is operational, not proof of zero profitability.
verdictPolicy.unknown: Any material family, ledger, fee, execution, capacity, drawdown, data, holdout, registry, authorization, open or result fact that is missing or not canonically bound is UNKNOWN; FAIL without verified result or independently proven contamination is UNKNOWN.
verdictPolicy.verifiedPositive: All seven families are terminal with exact ledgers; one deterministic winner passes family Holm, simultaneous net LCB, fee, capacity, drawdown, execution, sample, PBO, provenance and untouched-holdout gates; the same immutable winner then passes one fresh post-freeze holdout at alpha 1/40.

winnerPolicy.terminalUniverseLaw: All seven families must be terminal and adjudicable; pending exact attempt ledgers remain UNKNOWN.
